jobs.name: 生鏽小刀
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one inventory item icon for Wasteland Chronicles, an understated late-1990s isometric wasteland RPG with a Survivor PDA interface.
Style: original realistic hand-painted game item illustration, restrained coarse texture, clear bold silhouette, lightly weathered utilitarian materials; no cartoon, no vector clipart, no shiny mobile-game rendering.
Camera and lighting: three-quarter object view, soft light from upper left, readable pale edge against charcoal UI. Muted olive, brown canvas, dirty ivory, rust and steel palette.
Composition: one centered object, entire silhouette visible, approximately 80 percent of square 1024x1024 canvas with transparent margins. It must remain identifiable when displayed at32 to48 pixels.
Background: real transparent alpha. No floor, cast shadow outside object, scene, vignette, card, frame or interface. No text, letters, numbers, branding, logos or watermark.
This is a single game prop, no people, hands, mannequin, blood or extra objects.
Subject: One small simple utility knife: short straight pitted steel blade with dull rust patches, modest pointed tip, plain worn dark wooden handle held by two rivets, very little guard. Entire knife diagonal from lower-left handle to upper-right blade, clearly compact and inexpensive. No sheath.
